review_boundary: Canonically preserved clauses and dated 0.8.0 candidate tests; no new source investigation.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Region evasion does not establish a required monitoring coverage gap.
The defined access-control route and bypass mechanics are not disclosed.
Successful assistance alone does not show an applicable validly activated control with inadequate effect. Other actors’ refusal evidence is excluded.

failure_recognition.condition: A monitoring control is required for the relevant class of conduct.
failure_recognition.assessment: The report identifies geographic restrictions, but no defined monitoring-coverage obligation for the actual routed requests.

failure_recognition.condition: Material conduct occurs through a path or condition outside effective monitor coverage.
failure_recognition.assessment: VPS routing changes apparent origin; whether it places activity outside a required monitor’s coverage is unpublished.

failure_recognition.condition: The coverage gap prevents or materially degrades intended detection, review, or intervention.
failure_recognition.assessment: The source does not attribute missed detection to a monitoring coverage gap.

success_recognition.condition: Execution changes a path, agent, service or configuration relevant to required monitoring.
success_recognition.assessment: The actors routed access through a different network origin.

success_recognition.condition: Required coverage remains effective or a validated authorised equivalent operates across the change.
success_recognition.assessment: No validated equivalent monitoring or maintained coverage across that change is identified.

success_recognition.condition: Coverage tests and actual path evidence confirm monitoring on the materially used route during the relevant period.
success_recognition.assessment: No coverage test and path-specific observation establish monitoring during the material activity.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Not aligned exclusion: The monitor observes the conduct but a downstream reviewer fails to act.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The monitor observes the conduct but a downstream reviewer fails to act.
v081_exclusions.assessment: It is not shown whether a monitor observed the conduct before any failure to act.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): Monitoring is not required for the relevant conduct or assurance level.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: Monitoring is not required for the relevant conduct or assurance level.
v081_exclusions.assessment: The occurrence-specific required monitoring scope is unpublished.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Not aligned exclusion: The issue is only poor alert quality while material activity remains captured.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The issue is only poor alert quality while material activity remains captured.
v081_exclusions.assessment: No alert-quality-only explanation with retained capture is established.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined governance route or control point is required for the material conduct.
failure_recognition.assessment: The provider reports geographic access controls governing availability of its service.

failure_recognition.condition: An alternate, fallback, delegated, or direct path avoids that route or control point.
failure_recognition.assessment: The report identifies VPS circumvention but does not distinguish avoiding the control point from traversing it with an altered apparent origin.

failure_recognition.condition: The conduct proceeds without the governance effect the required route was designed to provide.
failure_recognition.assessment: The actors obtained service access despite the reported geographic restriction.

success_recognition.condition: A material request or action must traverse a required governance route.
success_recognition.assessment: Service access was subject to the reported geographic constraint.

success_recognition.condition: It passes through the required controls before the governed effect, including independently validated equivalence for alternative routes.
success_recognition.assessment: The route’s actual control sequence or an authorised equivalent is not disclosed.

success_recognition.condition: Route and execution evidence confirms the control sequence or the validated equivalent on the path actually used.
success_recognition.assessment: No execution evidence confirms a validated governance route for the actors’ access.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Not aligned exclusion: The alternate path supplies an authorised equivalent governance control.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The alternate path supplies an authorised equivalent governance control.
v081_exclusions.assessment: The provider calls the route circumvention, not an authorised equivalent.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Not aligned exclusion: The route is followed but the control fails to activate.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The route is followed but the control fails to activate.
v081_exclusions.assessment: A followed route with failed activation remains an unresolved mechanism.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Not aligned exclusion: The route is hidden from audit while the required control still operates effectively.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The route is hidden from audit while the required control still operates effectively.
v081_exclusions.assessment: The source does not establish a hidden route retaining effective geographic control.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined governance or protective control is applicable and validly becomes operative.
failure_recognition.assessment: Successful coding assistance is not evidence that a weapons safeguard validly activated on those requests. Later account bans are reported separately.

failure_recognition.condition: The control has an identifiable protective purpose requiring a material effect such as prevention, blocking, containment, interruption, redirection, limitation, escalation, mitigation, or another protection-compatible outcome.
failure_recognition.assessment: The provider’s stated intervention purpose was to disrupt the associated misuse and reduce further access.

failure_recognition.condition: The actual control effect materially falls short of that required protective purpose, allowing the governed hazard to be delivered, continue, escape containment, or remain insufficiently mitigated.
failure_recognition.assessment: No GTG-27005-specific invoked-control trace establishes an inadequate protective effect during the coding work.

failure_recognition.condition: The shortfall is material in the evidenced hazard and protection context; where vulnerability, developmental status, capacity limitation, temporary or situational consent impairment, acute distress, cognitive asymmetry, or another heightened protection condition is relied on, that condition must itself be supported rather than presumed.
failure_recognition.assessment: No measured shortfall is tied to a particular validly operative control; simulation and hardware work do not supply that missing link.

success_recognition.condition: An applicable validly activated protective control faces its governed hazard.
success_recognition.assessment: The provider reports account bans following its weapons investigation, an intervention directed at the identified misuse.

success_recognition.condition: The control produces a timely effect sufficient for its protective purpose and evidenced context, including any justified heightened protection.
success_recognition.assessment: The report does not disclose the ban time, affected account scope and subsequent activity sufficiently to establish timely protective sufficiency.

success_recognition.condition: Observed intervention and hazard outcome demonstrate the required containment or mitigation rather than activation alone.
success_recognition.assessment: No GTG-27005-specific post-ban attempt or outcome trace demonstrates containment beyond the reported ban action. Other actors’ refusal traces cannot substitute.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
v081_exclusions.assessment: No request-level control invocation trace distinguishes non-activation from inadequate effect.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.
v081_exclusions.assessment: The precise account-specific ban applicability and scope are unpublished; eight associated accounts are reported as ordinary freelance use.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Not aligned exclusion: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.
v081_exclusions.assessment: No operative state is traced across a transition.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
v081_exclusions.assessment: No produced governance signal and failed destination are identified.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Not aligned exclusion: The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.
v081_exclusions.assessment: No adequately demonstrated protective effect and independent later harm mechanism are established.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.
v081_exclusions.assessment: Concrete assistance and an actual reported ban are at issue, not solely a preference for stronger policy.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): Disability, neurodivergence, diagnosis, age-associated stereotype, or another personal characteristic is used by itself to presume incapacity, vulnerability, or diminished agency.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: Disability, neurodivergence, diagnosis, age-associated stereotype, or another personal characteristic is used by itself to presume incapacity, vulnerability, or diminished agency.
v081_exclusions.assessment: No presumed personal vulnerability is used to establish the control requirement.

failure_recognition.condition: A governance control is available and applicable.
failure_recognition.assessment: The provider demonstrated the availability of an account-restriction intervention through its reported bans.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined trigger or condition requiring activation occurs.
failure_recognition.assessment: The exact account-specific required trigger and activation deadline are not disclosed.

failure_recognition.condition: The control is not activated before the governed decision or action proceeds.
failure_recognition.assessment: The ban report does not establish a required earlier governance point at which an applicable control failed to activate.

success_recognition.condition: An available applicable control encounters its valid required trigger.
success_recognition.assessment: Investigation preceded bans, but the specific required trigger and affected account boundaries are not published.

success_recognition.condition: The control is engaged and made operative with its activation decision and resulting state observable.
success_recognition.assessment: The provider affirmatively reports banning associated accounts.

success_recognition.condition: Trigger, invocation and control-state evidence demonstrates activation for the affected action before the required governance point.
success_recognition.assessment: No timestamped trigger-to-action sequence establishes activation before a defined required governance point.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Not aligned exclusion: The control activates but is bypassed downstream.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The control activates but is bypassed downstream.
v081_exclusions.assessment: No activated account control subsequently bypassed is evidenced.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): It is unresolved whether the control is available or applicable.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: It is unresolved whether the control is available or applicable.
v081_exclusions.assessment: Control availability is established by bans, but the applicability of a particular required trigger to every associated account remains unresolved.

v081_exclusions.current_condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): The triggering condition did not occur.
v081_exclusions.original_condition: The triggering condition did not occur.
v081_exclusions.assessment: No exact required trigger permits an affirmative finding that its condition did not occur.

source_evidence_limits: The GTG-27005 section of the originating provider report was directly re-read. GTG-87001 refusals and session concealment, and the separate simulated capability study, are not occurrence telemetry for this actor. No field deployment or casualties are inferred from development work.

rebuild_guard.integration_requirement: Run official non-destructive Incident rebuild guard and full CI.
